Now decide: buy AAPL within mandate. Max $10,000 per order, $20,000 total today. Cash $50,000. Buy-only.

At ~$222.70, $10,000 / 222.70 = 44.9 shares. So 44 shares = $9,798.80. That's within $10,000.

Actually to be safe for execution, limit slightly above ask: 222.80. Still close to market. 44 shares × 222.80 = $9,803.20 < $10,000. Good.
